2026-12-10.title: Second Thursday of Annunciation
2026-12-10.readTitle: Readings of the day (First Set; verify with the 2026–27 calendar)
readings: Love one another with mutual affection
2026-12-10.verse: And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord.
theo: Having received the Word, Mary does not stay at home; she goes “with haste” into the hill country to serve her elderly cousin. When Elizabeth hears her greeting, the child John leaps in her womb and she is filled with the Holy Spirit: “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb… And why has this happened to me, that the mother of my Lord comes to me?”

Paul's words describe Mary's visit: “Let love be genuine… love one another with mutual affection… rejoice with those who rejoice.” Faith that receives Christ becomes charity that carries him to others. The ark of the covenant once rested three months in the house of Obed-edom and brought blessing; Mary, the new ark, stays three months with Elizabeth.
outline: Ask: whom could you visit this Advent season?
Faith sets Mary on the road to serve.
Christ's presence brings joy and the Spirit.
Point 3 · Blessed is she who believed
Mary's faith is her deepest blessing.
live: Visit an elderly or lonely relative this week.
Celebrate someone else's good news sincerely today.
2026-12-10.prayer: Holy Mary, you hurried to serve Elizabeth and carried Jesus to her. Teach me to carry Christ to others with genuine love and joyful faith. Amen.
altar: Every Holy Qurbana is a Visitation: Christ comes to us hidden, and our hearts leap for joy. Then we carry him to others.

quick: Mary went with haste to serve.
Christ's presence brings joy: John leaped in the womb.
2026-12-10.action: Visit an elderly or lonely relative this week.
2026-12-10.question: Whom is God asking me to visit?

family.explain: Mary hurried to help her cousin Elizabeth. When she arrived, baby John jumped for joy because Jesus was near.
family.intention: We pray for people who need a visit: the sick, the old, the lonely and new mothers.
family.ask: Ask: “Whom can our family visit before Christmas?”

pm.open: Lord Jesus, hidden in Mary's womb you brought joy to Elizabeth's home. Come into our gathering, fill us with your Spirit, and send us to visit others with love. Amen.
share: Mary went with haste to help (Luke 1:39). What makes me slow to help others?
Paul says: rejoice with those who rejoice, weep with those who weep (Romans 12:15). Whom do I need to accompany now?
Whom will I visit before Christmas?
pm.resp: Lord, make us bearers of your joy.
interc: For the Church, that she may go out in haste to serve those in need.
For pregnant mothers and their babies, that they may be safe and joyful.
For the elderly and lonely, that they may receive visits of love this Christmas.
For those who are grieving, that they may be comforted.
For our prayer group, that we may love one another with genuine affection.
pm.close: Lord God, you sent Mary with haste to serve Elizabeth. Make our love genuine and active, and let our visits carry your Son to all who need him. Amen.

illus: In a village near Pala, a group of mothers began visiting new mothers in the parish for the first forty days after birth, bringing food and helping with housework. One young mother said: “I felt as if Mary herself had come to my house.”

homily: Dear friends, St Paul gives the Romans a list of what Christian love looks like in practice: let love be genuine; hate what is evil, hold fast to what is good; love one another with mutual affection; outdo one another in showing honour (Romans 12:9–10).

He continues: rejoice in hope, be patient in suffering, persevere in prayer; contribute to the needs of the saints; extend hospitality to strangers; bless those who persecute you; rejoice with those who rejoice, weep with those who weep (Romans 12:12–15). This is not a feeling; it is a way of life.

In the Gospel we see that love in action. Mary has just received the most astonishing news in history: she will be the mother of the Messiah. What does she do? She sets out and goes with haste to a Judean town in the hill country, to help her old cousin Elizabeth (Luke 1:39).
Mary does not stay at home to think about her own dignity. She travels many miles on foot to serve someone in need. Real grace always moves us outward, towards others.

When Mary greets Elizabeth, the child in Elizabeth's womb leaps for joy, and Elizabeth is filled with the Holy Spirit. She cries out: blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb; and blessed is she who believed (Luke 1:41–45). Jesus, hidden in Mary, brings joy and the Spirit into that home.
We too carry Christ when we visit others with love. A visit to a lonely grandmother, a sick neighbour, a family in grief, a new mother: these are little Visitations. Christ goes with us.

This Nombu, let us make one Visitation: someone who needs company, help or comfort. Go with haste, as Mary did. And let us be people who rejoice with those who rejoice and weep with those who weep. Amen.
kids: Children, Mary hurried to help her cousin. Who can you help at home today without being asked?

intro: The Visitation: faith becomes charity; Mary carries Christ to Elizabeth.

sub: The ark of the covenant brought blessing to Obed-edom's house for three months.
Mary, carrying Christ, stays three months with Elizabeth.
q: The ark of the LORD remained in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-edom and all his household.
In those days Mary set out and went with haste to a Judean town in the hill country.
points.apply: Bring Christ's blessing to one home this week.

sub: John leaps for joy before he is born.
Elizabeth is filled with the Holy Spirit.
q: The LORD, your God, is in your midst, a warrior who gives victory.
For as soon as I heard the sound of your greeting, the child in my womb leaped for joy.
points.apply: Share your joy in Christ with someone today.

sub: Our blessing too is in believing God's word.
q: O daughter, you are blessed by the Most High God above all other women on earth.
And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord.
points.apply: Visit an elderly or lonely relative this week.

concl: Faith that receives Christ carries him to others.
Let us visit, serve and rejoice.
2026-12-10.resolve: Make one visit of charity before Christmas.
